description: This file contains class prototypes and definitions for representing GLES 3 Vertex Array Objects within the ANGLE project, including VertexArray and VertexArrayState classes, with methods for managing vertex attributes, bindings, and related state.

classes.name: VertexArray
classes.description: Represents a GLES 3 Vertex Array Object, managing vertex attributes, bindings, and state synchronization.

classes.name: VertexArrayState
classes.description: Holds the state of a Vertex Array, including attributes, bindings, and validation caches.

methods.name: getLabel
methods.description: Returns the label of the VertexArrayState or VertexArray.

methods.name: setAttribBinding
methods.description: Sets the binding for a specific vertex attribute.

methods.name: hasEnabledNullPointerClientArray
methods.description: Checks if there are enabled client arrays with null pointers.

methods.name: getBindingToAttributesMask
methods.description: Returns a mask of attributes using a specific binding.

methods.name: detachBuffer
methods.description: Detaches a buffer from the VertexArray.

methods.name: setVertexAttribDivisor
methods.description: Sets the divisor for instanced rendering for a vertex attribute.

methods.name: enableAttribute
methods.description: Enables or disables a vertex attribute.

methods.name: setVertexAttribPointer
methods.description: Defines an array of vertex attribute data.

methods.name: setVertexAttribFormat
methods.description: Specifies the format of a vertex attribute.

methods.name: bindVertexBuffer
methods.description: Binds a buffer to a vertex buffer binding point.

methods.name: setVertexAttribBinding
methods.description: Associates a vertex attribute with a binding point.

methods.name: getIndexRange
methods.description: Retrieves the index range for draw calls, with caching.
